name: LuaRenamer
overview: Lua scripting environment for renaming and moving video files. Provides a powerful Lua 5.4 interface for custom file organization.

releases.release_notes:
Update Abstractions, a bunch of refactoring, dependencies, and CI bullshit

* Add Claude Code GitHub Workflow by @Mik1ll in https://github.com/Mik1ll/LuaRenamer/pull/145

* Relock all NuGet lock files on Dependabot PRs by @Mik1ll in https://github.com/Mik1ll/LuaRenamer/pull/150
